title: Is Niko Bellic in GTA 6? Return, mission, and voice actor explained

If you’re wondering if Niko Bellic returns in Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6), then read on for spoilers about the GTA 4 protagonist. We also go over Niko Bellic’s GTA 6 voice actor.

Is Niko Bellic in GTA 6? The answer is yes. The character from GTA 4 appears in the fifth chapter of GTA 6. To be specific, he’s in a cutscene during the Taking Liberties mission .

All Casino locations in GTA 6 & how to gamble
content:
There are dozens and dozens of possible side activities and different locations to see on the map of Leonida in Grand Theft Auto 6 . From robbing banks to racing in mud to performing base jumps off buildings, it’s truly staggering what you can do right from the start of the game. However, one of the most memorable side activities across the entire GTA franchise has been gambling at casinos, so you might be curious about where to find locations to bet your money in GTA 6.

Well, we have good news and bad news about the casinos in GTA 6. The good news is there are multiple casinos in Leonida, but the bad news is that you might not be able to use them to gamble for a while. We’ll explain more in the guide below.

There are two total casino locations in GTA 6, and they are actually fairly close to one another on the map. The first casino is simply called the “Vice City Casino,” and it’s located in southern Leonard County, east of Bellville and south of Waning Sands. The second casino is called Merlin’s Palace Casino, and it’s located in northwest Vice-Dale County, just south of Balsero and north of Salton.

You can see exact map screenshot locations for both casinos below.

If you’ve driven past these casinos during your time with GTA 6 so far, you might have attempted to enter them so you could throw some money at a craps or poker table. However, you were undoubtedly met with closed doors and no feasible way to get inside the casinos.

We can confirm that both the Vice City Casino and the Merlin’s Palace Casino are both fully closed to players during the entirety of GTA 6 . Even at the end of the game in Chapters 4 and 5, you will never receive access to the casinos. It’s unclear what Rockstar Games’ plans are for the casinos, but we would imagine that the developers are waiting for GTA Online to be released to make full use of them.

title: Esportes da Sorte investigation involves €360.4 million in frozen assets
content:
Brazilian authorities have frozen approximately €360.4 million in assets connected to Esportes da Sorte amid an investigation, according to the Ministry of Justice and Public Security.

According to Brazil’s Ministry of Justice and Public Security , the Federal Police conducted an investigation into illegal gambling. Called Operation Cash Out, the investigation launched on November 18, 2026 with the goal of dismantling a suspected illegal operation in Pernambuco involving gambling, betting, money laundering, currency evasion, and tax evasion, the noticed revealed.

Companies linked to the group allegedly operated betting services before obtaining authorization and transferred more than €500 million abroad. The Federal Revenue Service and Federal Public Prosecutor’s Office executed 59 search and seizure warrants as well, the post added.

According to Brazilian news outlet G1 , Darwin Henrique da Silva Filho, the owner of Esportes da Sorte, was one of the operation’s targets.

The Federal Revenue Service noted the alleged use of shell companies, national and foreign corporate structures, and financial mechanisms to hide financial transactions and the origin of funds.

The Federal Revenue Service also alleged that the group used individual taxpayer identification numbers, known as Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas (CPF) numbers in Brazil, belonging to deceased people and minors. Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica (CNPJ) numbers, which are Brazilian corporate taxpayer registration numbers, were used as well.

title: Ubisoft Establishes Motherbrain, a Studio Dedicated to Generative AI in Games
content:
One of the biggest gaming studios in the world, Ubisoft , has established a hyperfocused organisation, Motherbrain, dedicated to generative artificial intelligence and gameplay innovation. The studio will be developing proprietary AI tools that will support developers in adding a touch of realism to the game by making it more interactive.

According to Ubisoft CEO and co-founder Yves Guillemot, Motherbrain will be run by developers who are working on Teammates, a highly ambitious generative AI project. The group will now focus on developing tools that will aid other game developers to make their games richer, more immersive, and more engaging with the help of generative AI.

As Ubisoft continues to house other studios with an extensive portfolio of video games. Motherbrain will become part of the publisher’s new organisational structure, developing tools to aid everyone in game development.

Ubisoft seems to be going all-in on generative AI. title: LEC : fini les superteams, G2 défend son nouveau mercato
content:
Pourquoi bouleverser une équipe qui vient de remporter les trois splits du LEC ? C’est la question que se posent de nombreux supporters de G2 Esports depuis les premières annonces du mercato. Malgré sa domination sur la scène européenne, l’organisation a décidé de tourner une page importante de son histoire après une saison internationale contrastée. Finaliste du First Stand et demi-finaliste du MSI, G2 a ensuite déçu à l’Esports World Cup et aux Worlds 2026, avec deux éliminations prématurées.

Face aux critiques, Alban Dechelotte a tenu à expliquer la philosophie de ce nouveau projet. « Nous savons que cette intersaison vous a pris par surprise. Soyez assurés que nous n’avons pas pris ces décisions à la légère » , a déclaré le CEO sur X, promettant davantage d’explications prochainement. Avant d’insister sur le principal enseignement tiré des dernières saisons : « Nous avons appris que privilégier la cohésion d’équipe est plus important que de construire une superteam pour remporter l’intersaison sur le papier. » Une approche qu’il estime notamment à l’origine des succès européens de G2 et de ses victoires face aux formations asiatiques.

Cette volonté de changement devrait se traduire par un profond remaniement de l’effectif. BrokenBlade serait en route vers Movistar KOI, tandis que SkewMond devrait rejoindre la Karmine Corp et que le départ de Labrov a déjà été officialisé. Pour les remplacer, G2 aurait choisi le toplaner sud-coréen Rooster, le jungler Lyncas et le support Mikyx, attendu pour un nouveau passage sous les couleurs des Samouraïs. Caps et Hans sama seraient ainsi les deux seuls joueurs conservés, avec Mithy pressenti pour prendre les commandes du coaching staff après le départ de Perkz.

Un pari audacieux pour une organisation habituée à dominer le championnat européen. Mais Alban Dechelotte assume cette nouvelle direction et affiche sa confiance envers les joueurs et le staff. « Nous croyons en ce staff et en ce groupe de joueurs pour devenir le meilleur collectif possible. Quoi qu’il arrive, nous nous battrons toujours ensemble pour la victoire » , a-t-il conclu. Reste désormais à savoir si cette nouvelle formule permettra à G2 de conserver sa couronne en LEC tout en retrouvant les sommets sur la scène internationale.

title: Team SouL Secure PMGC 2026 Visas After Delay, 8Bit Thug Confirms
content:
Team SouL have secured all of their visas for the PUBG Mobile Global Championship (PMGC) 2026, clearing the way for India’s only team to travel to Turkey. S8UL co-founder Animesh “8Bit Thug” Agarwal confirmed the news on 20 November in his Instagram broadcast channel with a short message: “Visas secured.”

The update ends days of uncertainty around the squad’s travel plans. Only half of the players had received visas as of 19 November, and the rest of the applications were still under process with less than a day to spare.

On 19 November, S8UL’s Sid made a public appeal on X, warning that the team’s participation would be at risk if the remaining visas did not arrive by the next day. He tagged the Turkish Consulate General in Mumbai and asked fans to share the post . Sid later explained the team’s worst case scenario if the visas did not come through.

Within a day, 8Bit Thug confirmed the rest of the visas had come through. He did not say whether the consulate had responded to Sid’s appeal or share details of when the last approvals arrived. The Turkish consulate in Mumbai has not commented publicly.

The delay had been building for weeks. On 11 November, SouL Goblin said the visas were still being processed and hoped they would arrive early enough to give the team seven to eight days of practice in Turkey before the event.

With the visas secured, SouL can now finalise travel, but the late approval has cost them some of that practice window. The time matters because SouL play BGMI at home, while PMGC is played on PUBG Mobile, so players need to adjust to the global version of the game and local server conditions.

title: Sid Explains Team SouL’s Worst-Case Scenario Amid Visa Delays
content:
Siddhant “SID” Joshi recently took to X to reveal that half of Team SouL’s players are still waiting for Turkish visas just days before the PUBG Mobile Global Championship 2026 (PMGC 2026). Later, during a livestream, Sid opened up about the visa issues the team is facing, their efforts to contact the relevant authority, the support they have received from the community, and the worst case scenario they might have to face.

When Sid went live after posting a visa update on X, fans asked him about Team SouL’s visa status. Addressing fans’ concerns, he opened up about the entire issue. He started off by saying that the whole situation is weird. “The ones whose visas went in first still don’t have theirs. The ones who applied 3 days after us got their visas,” he explained.

Sid said his visa application was submitted in Mumbai three days before everyone else. Unlike some of the individuals whose applications were submitted in Delhi, he did not receive a request for additional documents. Their visas have since been approved, while his remains pending. “Mine (from Mumbai) should’ve come anyway, and mine is also still showing pending for some random reason. We applied for the Delhi visas on the 12th, and those visas came. They came yesterday. In fact the Mumbai ones should’ve come yesterday too, and they haven’t.”

Sid said Tencent has not given Team SouL a fixed deadline to reach the venue. “It’s not like tomorrow is the last date for travel. Nothing like that, I’m telling you guys. There’s no replacement team for us in the Gauntlet stage, so they haven’t given us any deadline like that.”

Sid said that the worst case scenario would be to take some emergency substitutes with approval (from Tencent). However, even that comes with a few caveats. “And for that I don’t know where we’d even find somebody… We can’t just pick up anyone and take them along like that. If our player doesn’t have a visa, then we’d have to decide on a new player, apply for their visa, get the visa, and only then could we go.”

Team SouL still have a few days to resolve their visa issues before they have to consider bringing in a substitute. Until then, the organization will try its best to get the visas approved so that the team can travel to the tournament as planned.

title: Cyberleek Claims It Leaked GTA 6’s Xbox Build, Key File Is Locked Behind a Meme Coin
content:
Cyberleek, the anonymous leaker behind months of stolen Grand Theft Auto VI footage, says it has put a full Xbox build of the game online, but with one file deliberately held back. According to a statement shared by the leaker on launch day, every file except the main executable is now circulating by torrent. Without that executable the game cannot run, and Cyberleek says it will release it on 23 November, or sooner if the market value of its own crypto token reaches $15 million.

None of it has been independently verified so far. No outlet or security researcher has confirmed that the files are a genuine GTA VI build, and Rockstar Games and Take-Two Interactive have not commented publicly. What is clear is that the stunt follows the same playbook Cyberleek has used since August, where each leak is tied to the price of a meme coin named after the leaker.

The statement, which was widely shared on X, says Cyberleek holds “the full November 2026 build of Grand Theft Auto VI”. It adds that this is an Xbox build, not a PC build, and claims the community will have it emulated inside a week. The cyber security news account International Cyber Digest reported the release at 8:37pm UTC on 19 November, the day the game launched around the world.

Comments on a since-removed Reddit post put the leaked files at around 200GB, close to the size of the real game on consoles. The official Xbox Series X and S version needs a similar download, as our download size guide explains. Rockstar opened the official pre-load on 10 November, as its Newswire post announced. A matching file size proves very little on its own, because anyone can package data to look like a full game.

The emulation claim is also hard to take at face value. No public emulator is known to run Xbox Series X and S games, and console builds are not designed to run outside the hardware they were made for. International Cyber Digest also reported that the same site is selling what it calls an older “development build” for $40 a download, which suggests the leak doubles as a sales pitch.

The countdown is the part that matters most to Cyberleek. The statement says the executable drops on 23 November with no conditions, unless the CYBERLEEK token reaches a $15 million market cap first, in which case it drops immediately. “30 million was too ambitious,” the statement says, adding that half “seems fair”.

title: Sony shares rise as PlayStation accounts for around 75% of GTA 6 sales
content:
The Nov. 19 release of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) caused Sony shares to climb after early sales estimates showed that PlayStation accounted for roughly 75% of Rockstar Games’ sales. This gave Sony a significant share of the highly anticipated game’s launch. While GTA 6 launched on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, its PC release remains uncertain.

According to data from Google Finance , Sony Corp. (TYO:6758) shares rose nearly 3% to 4,363 yen on Nov.19, outperforming a broader decline in Japanese technology stocks. The increase followed estimates from market research firm Sensor Tower , which indicated that GTA 6 recorded over 19 million units in sales during its initial release period.

According to the estimates, PlayStation accounted for approximately 75% of the total. Meanwhile, Microsoft’s Xbox represented the remaining 25%. The game launched exclusively on both platforms, with a PC version reportedly planned for 2027.

The game’s sales performance could help Sony address the slowing PlayStation hardware sales. Sony sold over 2.6 million PlayStation 5 consoles for the first half of 2026. This is a massive drop from the 4 million consoles shipped in the same quarter in 2025. Recent console price increases, driven partly by rising memory and electronic component costs, have put additional pressure on demand for the console.

However, despite the massive hype surrounding GTA 6 , some technical issues were being reported by players. Early reviews have pointed to performance issues on the standard PlayStation 5 while the more powerful PlayStation 5 Pro reportedly offers more stable performance.

Despite the concerns, GTA 6 still received widespread critical praise. It’s turning out to be one of the biggest releases in the gaming industry. The game is looking to surpass the milestone GTA 5 had, which was released roughly 13 years ago. However, GTA 6 does not have an online multiplayer expansion at the moment, which was one of the biggest revenue drivers behind GTA 5’s long-term commercial success.

title: GTA 6 Ultimate Edition versus Standard Edition: What’s the difference?
content:
The main difference between the Standard and Ultimate editions of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) is the additional in-game content. Both editions include the full game, the Vintage Vice City Pack, and one free month of GTA+. However, GTA 6 Ultimate Edition does add in some exclusive vehicles, weapons, customization options, businesses, and more. Here’s everything included in each option to help you decide whether the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition is worth it.

The Standard Edition of GTA 6 is available in digital and the code-in-box formats. It includes the base game, GTA+, and the Vintage Vice City Pack. GTA+ refers to a subscription that grants you in-game benefits and access to select games in the GTA+ Games Library. GTA+ members on console can also get the ’90 Annis Venturas BLVD Elegy sports car and a garage in Crosstown. These can be claimed in GTA 6 chapter 3 .

The Ultimate Edition includes everything in the Standard Edition plus the following additional content. These extras include more vehicles, weapons, customization options, and businesses that you can visit in GTA 6.

The Standard Edition of GTA 6 includes the base game and two limited-time bonuses. These are the Vintage Vice City Pack and a free month of GTA+. Meanwhile, the Ultimate Edition of GTA 6 includes all of the Standard Edition’s content plus additional vehicles, weapons, character and vehicle customization options, and exclusive businesses.

title: How to sell cars, motorcycles, and bikes for money in GTA 6
content:
Vehicles are one of the key focal points throughout the entirety of Grand Theft Auto 6. They play a major role in the story as well as the side content, as there are challenges, story missions, and more centered around them. However, aside from using cars, bikes, and other vehicles for your own personal use, you can also choose to sell them to turn a quick profit in GTA 6.

Money is always at the forefront of your mind when playing GTA 6, and selling vehicles is one of the best ways to earn a fast buck. Unfortunately, you won’t get the ability to sell cars and other vehicles until a certain point in the story. So, let’s see exactly how and when you can start to sell vehicles in GTA 6.

At the start of GTA 6, you’ll be unable to acquire any personal vehicles aside from Jason’s Vapid Granada and his motorcycle (the latter of which is only unlocked with the Ultimate Edition). This remains the case until you’ve made it out of Key Lento by progressing the story to Chapter 2.

Near the beginning of Chapter 2, you’ll meet an NPC named Moses at his auto garage in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County. Moses spills the beans about selling, registering, and fixing cars, and this is the first location where you can sell a vehicle in GTA 6.

However, Moses will only take older vehicles; notably, vehicles that don’t have a tracker. Trackers have two levels, yellow and red, and allow police to ping a stolen vehicle’s location on the map. You are completely unable to sell vehicles with a red tracker, and red trackers can never be removed from a vehicle in GTA 6.

As for yellow trackers, you can take these vehicles and any car, motorcycle, or bike without a tracker to a Pay ‘N’ Spray shop in Leonida. These are found all over the map, marked with a spray paint can icon, and will buy any vehicle that doesn’t have a red tracker. You can see the sell price for a vehicle you’re currently driving by hovering over a Pay ‘N’ Spray’s icon on your map.

title: Does GTA 6 autosave? Answered
content:
Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) has finally launched for everyone, and some players are wondering if it has an autosave system in place.

Yes, GTA 6 has an autosave feature. Like its namesake, this feature automatically saves your progress after certain activities such as completing missions. GTA 6 uses one dedicated slot for this feature as well, which automatically overwrites your previous autosave.

You can also manually save your progress in GTA 6 if you would like to revisit certain points of your playthrough. Where you save doesn’t matter much, either. That’s because unlike GTA 5, you don’t need to be in a safehouse to save your progress.

To manually create a save file, pause GTA 6, and choose the “Game” option from the menu. Next, choose “Save Game” and pick an empty save slot.

Accessing a save file follows similar steps. Simply pause GTA 6, select “Game” from the menu on your PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S, and choose the “Load Game” option. Then, select one of your save files to load it in.

While trying to manually save your game, the “Save Game” option may be grayed out. That’s because GTA 6 doesn’t allow you to do manual saves during missions. You cannot save while you’re going through the game’s prologue, either.

content:
Le phénomène Grand Theft Auto VI n’aura pas attendu longtemps pour faire tomber les records. Sorti ce mercredi 18 novembre, le nouveau jeu de Rockstar Games a attiré des millions de spectateurs sur les plateformes de streaming dès ses premières heures. title: GTA 6 Broke an Internet Traffic Record, but Not the One You’re Seeing on X
content:
Grand Theft Auto VI has pushed internet traffic to a new record, but the viral claim that it broke the record for “highest ever internet usage” goes further than the data does. The figure doing the rounds, 33.03 terabits per second, comes from DE-CIX, the operator of some of the world’s biggest internet exchanges. It measures the combined traffic across DE-CIX’s own exchanges around the world, not the whole internet.

The film news account DiscussingFilm shared the number on X, citing Variety, and the post has spread quickly through gaming circles. DE-CIX says the peak came at 8:20pm Central European Time on 18 November, which is 7:20pm UTC. That was almost four hours before GTA VI unlocked in Central Europe at midnight local time, as our GTA 6 launch live blog tracked.

In its press release on 19 November, DE-CIX said traffic across all of its exchanges worldwide reached 33.03 terabits per second. An internet exchange is a hub where internet providers, content networks and cloud companies swap traffic directly with each other. More than 1,100 networks connect at DE-CIX Frankfurt alone, which the company calls Europe’s largest internet exchange, and it also runs exchanges in cities including New York, Dallas, Madrid, Dubai and Singapore.

That makes DE-CIX a useful gauge of how hard a launch hits the networks, but it is one operator’s view. A large share of game downloads travels through content delivery networks and private connections between networks, which never pass through a public exchange like DE-CIX. A record at DE-CIX is a record for DE-CIX, which is still a big deal, but it is not a measure of total internet usage around the world.

Overall traffic around the launch ran about 25% above a typical week at the start of 2026, according to the release. DE-CIX chief technology officer Thomas King put the scale of the moment simply. “For millions of gamers, downloading a game is just a single click,” he said, adding that DE-CIX is “extremely well prepared for traffic peaks of this kind”.

The launch record is far narrower than the headlines suggest. The previous worldwide high of 33.01 terabits per second was set on 10 November, when Rockstar opened the GTA VI pre-load, as its Newswire post announced at the time. The launch peak beat that mark by just 0.02 terabits per second.

title: Apex Legends Pathfinder guide: how to play the most picked Legend
content:
Two grapples, a zipline every two minutes and no changes in Season 31: on 19 November, Pathfinder is first in the pick rates from Silver to Apex Predator, and the reasons are easy to learn.

Most Ranked points are not lost in fights. They are lost between them: the squad that leaves a building ten seconds late, gets caught in the open by a team on a hill and never reaches the next ring. Aim does not fix that. Position does, and no Legend in Apex Legends hands out position as freely as Pathfinder.

That is why he sits on top of the pick rates. On apexlegendsstatus.com on Thursday 19 November 2026 he is the most played Legend among all players at 12.7%, and his share grows with every rank: 9.5% in Silver, 12.5% in Gold, 15.5% in Platinum, 17.5% in Diamond and 19.0% in Master and Apex Predator. Roughly one in five players at the top of the ladder is a Pathfinder.

He got there without help from the current patch. Season 31, Cipher, which went live on Tuesday 3 November 2026, buffed Crypto, Lifeline and Revenant and left Pathfinder alone. The kit he has now comes from the mid season patch on 23 June 2026, when EA gave him a second grapple and cut a minute off his ultimate. This guide explains that kit, the upgrades, how to play him in Ranked and public matches, who to pair him with and how to stop him. The season itself is covered in everything new in Season 31 .

Go back to the spring, and he was not. In the mid season patch notes from 22 June 2026, EA wrote that “your favourite friendly robot has been a bit outclassed by other skirmishers” and set out to improve the uptime on his abilities. The changes went live the next day:

The second grapple is the big one. With one charge, a Pathfinder had to choose between using the grapple to get into a fight and keeping it to get out. With two, he does both. That single change moved him from a Legend who was fun to a Legend who is correct.

content:
While gamers around the world were busy tuning in to GTA 6, Valve rolled out a major Dota 2 update that reshapes the game at its core. The highly anticipated Dota 2 Patch 7.42 went live at around 8 am UTC on November 19, and it changes the economy, the map, items, and most of the game’s hero roster, while also teasing what many players believe to be a brand-new hero.

Here’s everything you need to know about Dota 2’s latest update before you hop on your next ranked game.

The biggest highlight of the Dota 2 patch 7.42 is the fundamental change to hero stats. Base health for every hero in the game has been raised from 120 to 200, with each point of Strength now giving 20 health instead of 22.

The magic resistance from the Intelligence stat has also been raised from 0.1% to 0.125%. Additionally, the patch also tones down spell damage across the board and cuts some long-lasting slows, so fights should be a little less explosive.

Valve has added an “Item Potency” mechanic to Dota 2 with the 7.42 patch. Attacks from heroes (and hero-like units, including illusions) will now have an attribute called Item Potency . Effects from items like Desolator and Eye of Skadi now scale with the attack’s Item Potency, with illusions only getting a fraction of the full effect.

There’s also a crucial change to the game’s economy, as passive gold income no longer grows as the game goes on, and rewards for destroying buildings have been standardized and reduced across the board.

title: Rockstar Tells Tribunal Sacked Staff ‘Flouted’ Rules as Union Vote Runs Through GTA 6 Launch
content:
Rockstar Games spent the final days before Grand Theft Auto VI’s release defending itself at an employment tribunal in Glasgow, while more than 1,600 of its UK staff are eligible to vote on recognising a union. The case was brought by 23 former employees who say they were sacked for trade union activity, a claim Rockstar denies. Closing submissions were heard on 17 and 18 November, and no date has been set for a judgment.

The two events now overlap with the biggest launch in the studio’s history. The union recognition ballot opened on 12 November and closes on 26 November, so voting runs through launch week. The game itself went live around the world on 19 November, with our GTA 6 launch live blog tracking each regional unlock.

About 34 people were dismissed across the UK and Canada in October 2025, according to the Press Association . Rockstar says they were let go for gross misconduct after confidential company information was shared on a Discord server with hundreds of members. Its barrister, Thomas Cordrey, told the tribunal that the dismissals came down to the “flouting of contractual policies and obligations”.

“We know the policies, we know our employer would be opposed to the use of a semi-public Discord,” Cordrey also said in his closing. Rockstar’s case is that the workers knew the rules and broke them, rather than being targeted for joining a union. The case is being heard at the Glasgow Tribunals Centre before Employment Judge Lucy Wiseman, and our report from the October hearings covered earlier evidence about the Discord server.

Rockstar has stood by its decision throughout the case. “Individuals across the UK and Canada were dismissed for gross misconduct,” a spokesperson said, adding that the company remains “confident of a positive outcome”. The studio has not linked the dispute to the game’s release, and its public launch message from co-founder Sam Houser focused on players.

The 23 claimants are represented by the Independent Workers’ Union of Great Britain, known as the IWGB. Their lawyer, Richard O’Keeffe, argued in his closing submission that managers had known about the Discord server for around three years, according to a separate Press Association report . title: PSN Down Minutes After GTA 6 Launches in the US, PlayStation Store Goes Offline in Europe As Well
content:
Update, 6:02am UTC, 19 November: PlayStation’s status page no longer lists any problem in the Americas, so PS5 and PS4 players in the US, Canada and Latin America should be able to launch games again. The gaming and social problem in the UK and Europe has cleared too. Sony still lists a PlayStation Store outage for that region, now with a start time of 5:56am UTC.

PlayStation Network is having problems again, barely half an hour after Grand Theft Auto VI went live in the US and Canada. PlayStation’s official status page marked its “Gaming and social” service as degraded on PS5 and PS4 across the Americas at 5:33am UTC on 19 November. Sony’s notice warns that players “might have difficulty launching games, apps, or network features”, and says it is working to fix the issue as soon as possible.

The problem is not limited to North America. A minute later, at 5:34am UTC, the status page for the UK, Europe, the Middle East, Australia and New Zealand showed the same degraded gaming service and a full outage for the PlayStation Store. Sony’s store notice says players “might have difficulty getting products in PlayStation Store”, which hits anyone still trying to buy GTA VI on launch night.

GTA VI unlocked across the US and Canada at 5am UTC, which was midnight on the East Coast. The US unlock happened at the same moment in every time zone, so players in Chicago could start at 11pm, Denver at 10pm and Los Angeles at 9pm on 18 November. Rockstar’s support page on release times says the game releases at midnight local time in all regions.

US storefronts treated the whole country as a single release region keyed to Eastern time, as Forbes reported last week, and that is how the launch played out. Every US player could start at once, rather than in waves an hour apart, so West Coast players got the game three hours before their own midnight. Sony’s degraded notice for the Americas appeared 33 minutes after that unlock, and the notice does not give a cause.

Players who have already downloaded the game may still be able to start it, depending on how their PS5 is set up. Digital games usually run without a connection on a console that has Console Sharing and Offline Play turned on, which is normally switched on for the first PS5 an account signs into. You can check it under Settings, then Users and Accounts, then Other, then Console Sharing and Offline Play.

title: Take-Two Adds Billions in Market Value as GTA 6 Launches, Shares Close Up 6%
content:
Take-Two Interactive added billions of dollars to its stock market value on 18 November as Grand Theft Auto VI began rolling out worldwide. The publisher’s shares closed at $216.54, up 6.18% on the day, after rising as much as 8.8% during trading. The closing gain was worth about $2.4 billion in market value, and the rise briefly topped $3 billion at the intraday peak.

The rally lifted Take-Two’s market capitalisation from about $38.2 billion at Tuesday’s close to more than $40.5 billion during Wednesday’s session. Trading was unusually heavy, with around 12 million shares changing hands, roughly four times the stock’s recent daily average.

Take-Two finished Tuesday at $203.93 and opened Wednesday’s session at $212.64, already well above the previous close. Buyers pushed the stock to a high of $222.65 during the morning, before it eased in the afternoon to settle at $216.54. The day’s low of $210.50 still sat comfortably above Tuesday’s closing price.

The opening jump followed the review embargo, as the first GTA 6 reviews lifted Take-Two shares soon after the market opened in New York. Take-Two outpaced the wider market throughout the day, with the Nasdaq 100 tracking fund QQQ up only around 0.3% and the S&P 500 fund SPY slightly lower.

The gain also recovered much of a sharp slide earlier in the week. Take-Two had fallen about 10% over the two trading days before launch, as some investors sold ahead of the release. Even after Wednesday’s rally, the stock remains down around 14% for the year and well short of its 52 week high of about $266.

Early sales estimates gave investors the clearest reason to buy. Research firm Sensor Tower said GTA 6 had sold about 17.07 million units, worth around $1.65 billion, on launch day. That is more than double the $800 million GTA 5 made in its first 24 hours in 2013, which itself set records at the time.

title: Best GTA 6 Tips and Tricks for Beginners
content:
Grand Theft Auto VI changes more of the series’ core systems than any entry since GTA 5. Police remember what you wear, money can be lost on death, stats fade without training and completed story missions cannot be replayed. Players who carry old GTA habits into Leonida can lose cash, progress and hours of play.

These tips cover the systems that matter most in the first hours of the game, from saving and money to police, combat and character stats. They apply to both Jason and Lucia on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

GTA 6 has no mission replay menu, unlike GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2. The only way to play a story mission again is to load a manual save made before it, and the game offers 15 manual save slots. Our guide on why you cannot replay missions in GTA 6 explains how to plan those slots across the campaign.

A good habit is to save at the start of each chapter and before each heist. With 93 story missions spread across five chapters, the GTA 6 chapters and missions list helps players see which missions are coming and where a save makes sense.

Players can lose a large share of the cash they carry if Jason or Lucia dies during free roam or a mission. Keep most of your money in the Floor Stash at a safe house, or deposit it at the bank. Banking opens after the Buck Me mission in Chapter 1, and Jason has a hiding spot under his bedroom floorboards from early in the game.

Police in GTA 6 work from the details they have on a suspect, including appearance, clothing and getaway vehicle. Wearing a disguise before a robbery and changing outfits afterwards makes escapes far easier. Switching cars once officers have identified your vehicle also helps break their search.

title: GTA 6 Lucia Trailer vs Final Game: Players Split Over Upgrade or Downgrade
content:
Grand Theft Auto VI players are sharing side by side comparisons of Lucia Caminos from the game’s first trailer and the finished game, and the images have split the community. Some players say Rockstar Games improved her character model before launch, while others argue she looked better in the 2023 reveal. The debate took off within hours of the game’s release on 19 November.

The comparison that spread most widely places two near identical shots of Lucia next to each other. Both show her in an orange prison uniform beside a chain link fence, lit by a low evening sun, in the scene that opened the first trailer.

The two images match in framing, pose and setting, which makes the differences in detail easy to spot. One version shows stronger contrast, with deeper shadows across her face and richer orange light on her skin. The other has softer, flatter lighting that shows more of her facial features, hairline and the background through the fence.

Her hair, face shape and expression also differ slightly between the two shots. Players have pointed to changes around her eyes, jaw and the way her hair falls, though the scene is otherwise the same moment from the story. It is the opening of the game’s prologue, which the GTA 6 missions list shows as Lucia’s first mission.

Players who see an upgrade point to the added detail in her skin and features, saying the final model looks more natural and closer to a real person. Others say the trailer’s heavier lighting made the shot more cinematic, and that the final scene looks flatter by comparison. Several players have argued the gap comes down to lighting and post processing rather than a new model.

Trailers are often rendered with settings tuned for a single shot, while the finished game has to run the same scene on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S in real time. Rockstar has not commented on the comparison or said whether Lucia’s model changed after the first trailer.

title: How to Increase Max Health in GTA 6
content:
Grand Theft Auto VI tracks three core stats for Jason and Lucia: Health, Stamina and Focus. Max Health decides how much damage either character can take in a firefight, and it grows only through one type of activity. Some popular habits, including running, do nothing for it.

The game also separates permanent gains from short boosts, so players who stop training can lose part of the progress they built. Knowing which activities feed which stat saves hours of wasted effort.

Max Health in GTA 6 increases through strength training with weight equipment. Bench presses, deadlifts and chest flys all count, and each completed workout adds to the character’s health bar. Players need enough stamina to finish a set, because a workout ends early if the stamina bar runs out.

Jason’s house in Shoeless Keys has gym equipment, which makes it the easiest place to train early in the story. Players also need to train regularly, because health and stamina gains fade if Jason and Lucia stop working out.

Running does not increase Max Health. Cardio activities such as running, cycling and kayaking build the Stamina bar instead, and they also burn calories. Players who want more health have to lift weights, while those who want to sprint for longer should focus on cardio.

Focus works differently from the other two stats. It controls how long Jason and Lucia can slow down time while aiming, which pairs with the reticle options in our guide on changing the crosshair in GTA 6 . Mindfulness activities such as fishing and pool raise Focus, and those gains are permanent. Players heading out to fish can use the GTA 6 wildlife guide to see what lives in Leonida’s waters.

title: Is PSN Down? PlayStation Network Outage Hits Players Hours Before GTA 6 Launch

Millions of players downloading that update at the same time as their game files put extra load on the network. title: GTA 6 Camera Guide: How to Take Selfies, Change Filters and Use Photo Mode

The rear camera includes a flash toggle, a 3×3 grid, zoom up to 5x and up to 17 filters. Photos can be viewed afterwards through the Gallery option inside the camera app.

Players switch to selfie mode by choosing the Selfie option in the camera app, which flips the view to the front camera. The selfie view adds three new controls on top of the photo and flash buttons.

How to Change Weapon Crosshair in GTA 6
content:
Grand Theft Auto VI uses a three dash crosshair by default, which some players find harder to read than the single dot from GTA 5. Rockstar Games has included several reticle options in the game’s settings, covering the shape, size, visibility and hit markers.

The options sit inside the UI settings rather than the gameplay or controller menus, so they are easy to miss on a first look. The settings work the same way on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

The crosshair settings are listed under the Reticle section of the UI tab. Changes apply as soon as players close the menu, so they can test each shape and return to the settings if it does not suit them.

The Reticle section has six options. Reticle Shape decides the look of the crosshair, while the visibility sliders control how strongly it shows on screen when a weapon is held or aimed.

Complex is the default and changes shape depending on the equipped weapon. Simple and Dot use a smaller marker that stays the same across weapons, which is closer to the GTA 5 style. None removes the crosshair entirely, an option players can pair with a realistic aiming setup.

Hit markers add a brief signal on the crosshair when a shot lands, which helps confirm hits at long range. Turning them off gives a cleaner screen but removes that feedback. The two visibility sliders work separately, so players can keep the reticle faint while a weapon is simply held and make it stronger only when they aim down sights.

Huya Turns Its First Operating Profit Since 2022 as Game Publishing Outgrows Live Streaming
content:
Huya has posted its first operating profit in four years, as the Chinese game streaming platform leans harder on game publishing and in-game item sales to make up for a shrinking live streaming business. The NYSE-listed company reported operating income of RMB15.2 million (US$2.3 million) for the third quarter of 2026, against an operating loss of RMB14.3 million a year earlier. Acting chief executive Junhong Huang said operating income “turned positive for the first time since the third quarter of 2022”.

The results , released on 17 November for the quarter to 30 September, show a company in the middle of a shift. Total net revenues rose 3.8% to RMB1,752.8 million (US$261.4 million), but almost all of that growth came from outside live streaming. Net income attributable to Huya reached RMB29.3 million (US$4.4 million), up from RMB9.6 million in the same quarter last year.

Revenue from game-related services, advertising and other sources jumped 21.3% to RMB644.7 million (US$96.2 million), and Huya said the rise was driven mainly by in-game item sales and advertising. That line now makes up about 37% of total revenue, up from roughly 31% a year ago. Live streaming revenue, still the larger business, slipped to RMB1,108.2 million (US$165.3 million) from RMB1,156.7 million, a fall of about 4.2%. In money terms, the non-streaming business added RMB113.1 million year on year, while live streaming lost RMB48.5 million.

Huang pointed to game publishing as the main reason for the improvement. “Game publishing is becoming an increasingly important growth driver for our business,” he said, adding that Huya is advancing the release of The Legend of Swordman: Reunion and other titles. The company said it is drawing on what it learned from launching the mobile version of Goose Goose Duck. The release did not break out revenue for individual titles, and it did not give a launch date for The Legend of Swordman: Reunion.

The better revenue mix also helped Huya’s margins during the quarter. Gross profit rose 12.6% to RMB255.2 million (US$38.1 million), lifting gross margin to 14.6% from 13.4%. On a non-GAAP basis, operating income reached RMB30.5 million (US$4.6 million), which Huya said was its highest quarterly level since the third quarter of 2022. Non-GAAP net income attributable to Huya rose to RMB43.7 million (US$6.5 million), from RMB36.3 million a year earlier.

Huya said live streaming revenue “continued to stabilize” compared with the previous quarter, but it is still lower than a year ago. Huya built its business on game and esports live streaming in China, so the live streaming line remains the core of the platform. The Q3 release does not give monthly active user numbers, so it offers no direct read on whether its audience is growing. Live streaming still brought in about 63% of revenue in the quarter, down from about 69% a year earlier.

title: Oppenheimer Sets GTA 6’s Bar at 20 Million Copies in Three Days as Take-Two Stock Jumps 7%
content:
Oppenheimer has reiterated its Outperform rating on Take-Two Interactive with a $280 price target, and its launch-week note sets a clear bar for Grand Theft Auto VI. The broker expects about 20 million copies sold and at least $1.85 billion in gross revenue in the game’s first three days, according to a summary of the note published by Investing.com . Take-Two shares were trading at $218.92 at 12:53pm ET on Wednesday, up 7.35% on the day, according to Google Finance .

That price leaves about 28% of upside to Oppenheimer’s target. The stock had fallen almost 12% over the previous week, according to the same report, and our earlier analysis of the rebound covers how the reviews turned that around. Trading volume had reached 6.8 million shares by early afternoon, roughly double the stock’s average daily volume of 3.34 million. The shares opened at $212.64, dipped as low as $201.66 and climbed to an intraday high of $221.83, giving Take-Two a market value of about $40.9 billion.

The note lays out four markers that investors can check against the launch as it happens. Oppenheimer expected an aggregate Metacritic score of 97 or higher and a Twitch peak of about 2 million viewers. Its sales tests are around 20 million units in three days and gross revenue of $1.85 billion or more over the same period. It also flagged cyberattacks on console networks as the main launch-day risk.

Two of those tests have already been passed. GTA VI holds a 99 Metascore from 147 critic reviews, which our reviews roundup tracked as the embargo lifted, and that beats the 97 Oppenheimer set as its benchmark. On Twitch, the game’s category page passed 3 million concurrent viewers on 18 November, well above both the 2 million estimate and the 1.82 million peak the note cites for the gameplay reveal.

The sales tests will take longer to settle. Oppenheimer used a Sensor Tower estimate of 15.88 million pre-ordered units as a comparison point, and it said Take-Two could share its first sales figure as early as 20 November. A first-weekend update could follow on 23 November, which would give investors a direct read on the 20 million target.

Oppenheimer is not alone in staying bullish through the launch. After Take-Two’s second-quarter results earlier this month, DA Davidson kept a Buy rating with a $300 target, Piper Sandler held Overweight at $290 and BMO Capital stayed at Outperform with $285. TD Cowen kept its Buy rating at $284, while UBS cut its target from $300 to $295 and kept its Buy call. Our analysis earlier this week found an average TipRanks target of $290.50, close to where most of these brokers sit.

title: GTA 6 Streamers Are Getting YouTube Warnings Over In-Game Nudity: How to Avoid a Strike
content:
GTA 6 streamers on YouTube are reporting Community Guidelines warnings after in-game nudity appeared on their live broadcasts, and the timing could not be worse for anyone planning a launch marathon. Streamer Frag, who posts as @FragDempsey on X, shared a screenshot on 18 November showing his GTA 6 live stream removed under YouTube’s “Nudity and sexual content” policy. His advice to other creators was blunt: do not go into the game’s strip club while you are live.

DON’T GO IN THE STRIP CLUB IN GTA6 WHILE LIVE I GOT BANNED ON YOUTUBE LMAOOOO

A second warning seen by TalkEsport, for a stream titled “Grand Theft Auto 6 – Race to 100% Completion!”, cites the same policy and points to a moment 33 minutes and 30 seconds into the broadcast. Both notices are formal warnings, not channel bans, though Frag described his as a ban in his post. That difference matters, because a warning can turn into a strike, and a strike blocks live streaming for a week.

Grand Theft Auto VI is made for a mature audience, and its rating says so. The ESRB rates it M for Mature 17+ , and its content descriptors include Nudity and Strong Sexual Content alongside Intense Violence and Use of Drugs and Alcohol. A mature rating on the game does not change what YouTube allows on its own platform, though.

YouTube’s nudity and sexual content policy applies to live streams as well as uploaded videos, and it covers illustrated and animated content, including video games. It bans the depiction of clothed or unclothed genitals, breasts or buttocks that is meant for sexual gratification. Content with nudity that does not cross that line can be age-restricted instead, and YouTube weighs whether body parts are the focal point and whether the imagery is fleeting or prolonged.

Live streams make that line harder to manage. On an uploaded video, a creator can trim or blur a scene before anyone sees it, but on a live broadcast every second goes out unedited. Time spent inside a club venue in a game rated for nudity was enough for YouTube to remove Frag’s stream, according to his screenshot.

STILL RUNNING THE PITCH.”, while the jacket’s page promises “terrace heritage” and a “villain mentality”. Every piece is co-branded, so this is a shared product line instead of a G2 kit with a sponsor logo added. The clothing is listed in sizes starting from XS, while the beanie comes in a single size.

Both companies framed the drop as more than a logo swap. “It is really special to partner with a deeply authentic brand like Umbro,” said Sabrina Ratih, chief operating officer of G2 Esports, in the announcement. “We wanted to do more than put two logos on a collection,” she added, describing team identity as something fans wear every day.

Markus Ley of Umbro Germany pointed to the overlap between the two audiences. “We are excited to bring Umbro’s rich sporting DNA into gaming and connect with a new generation of fans,” he said. Ley also said football and esports fans share the same passion, energy and sense of community, which is the idea the whole collection is built around. The announcement does not say who designed the pieces or where they are made, unlike G2’s own jerseys.

title: Epic Takes Legal Action Against a Rocket League Cheat Seller, Bans Them From Every Epic Game
content:
Epic Games says it has taken legal action against a seller of Rocket League cheats, and the seller is now permanently banned from every Epic game. According to the publisher, they published a note, under the “Update on our fight against cheating”, alongside a short apology video from the seller. Epic’s post was blunt about the reason, stating that selling cheats is against its rules.

The video, titled “An Apology to the Rocket League Community” and hosted on YouTube, is a plain text statement on a black background. “I sold cheats for Rocket League and that wasn’t fair,” the seller says in it, adding that cheating ruins matches for everyone. The statement ends by confirming they have stopped selling cheats and are banned from Rocket League and all other Epic Games products.

Epic has not said what form the legal action took. Its post does not mention a lawsuit, a court, a settlement or any payment, and it does not say how long the seller had been operating. What it does confirm is the outcome: the cheats are no longer for sale, the seller has apologised publicly, and the ban covers Epic’s whole catalogue instead of Rocket League alone.

That last point matters, because a ban across Epic Games products cuts the seller off from Fortnite, Rocket League, Fall Guys and anything else tied to an Epic account. Epic’s community rules tell players not to cheat, grief or exploit bugs, and not to promote or advertise known cheats. Selling them goes a step further, which is why Epic chose legal action in this case.

We are not naming the seller or the product here. TalkEsport does not publish the names of cheat sellers or cheat tools, even in enforcement stories, so readers are not pointed towards them. Epic named the seller in its own post on X, and the apology video is public on YouTube.

This is not the first time Epic has paired legal action with a public message. In July 2025, the Newsroom account said Epic had taken legal action against two people , one who sold and used cheats and another who carried out DDoS attacks on creators while they were livestreaming. Both were ordered to stop and banned from Epic’s games.

title: Krafton’s AI Horror Game MIMESIS Wins at the Korea Game Awards and Passes 2.4 Million Sales
content:
Krafton’s AI horror game MIMESIS has won an Excellence Award at the 2026 Korea Game Awards, and the publisher says the game has now sold more than 2.4 million copies worldwide. The co-op title from ReLU Games, a creative studio inside the BGMI and PUBG maker, picked up the prize at the ceremony at BEXCO in Busan on 18 November. Krafton’s announcement said judges rewarded the way the game builds artificial intelligence into its core design.

The Korea Game Awards are hosted by South Korea’s Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and organised by the Korea Association of Game Industry. Winners are judged on artistry, technology and popularity, with an expert panel counting for half of the score and public and media votes for a quarter each. MIMESIS shared the Excellence Award tier with Supercat’s Dokkaebi’s World and Com2uS’s MMORPG Zeus, while all four technical and creative awards went to Crimson Desert.

The night belonged to Pearl Abyss, whose Crimson Desert took the Grand Prize as part of the record eight-award haul we covered earlier . Crimson Desert has sold more than 6 million copies since its March release, according to the ministry. NC’s Aion 2 won the Prime Minister’s Award, while Nimble Neuron, the developer of Eternal Return, received the Esports Development Award. Culture minister Choi Hwi-young also used the evening to back a tax credit for game development .

MIMESIS is a four-player co-op horror game built around monsters that copy the people playing it. According to Krafton, the AI-driven enemies imitate a player’s appearance, actions and voice, so the person standing next to you might not be your teammate at all. The AI also reads its surroundings and reacts to what players do, which keeps the group guessing about who is real.

Krafton describes it as an “AI-native game”, meaning the AI is the main source of the experience instead of a background system. That design is what the Korea Game Awards judges singled out, according to the publisher. It also fits Krafton’s wider bet on AI, which in India includes a $250 million commitment to AI and deep tech startups announced in September.

ReLU Games has kept updating the monsters since launch. In October, to mark a year in Early Access, the studio released its second major update, called OFF THE RAILS. It added a feature that copies players’ habits and a new Paranoia system, both aimed at making the imitations harder to spot.

title: LCS : Zven aussi attendu chez FlyQuest

Un échec qui a poussé ses dirigeants à entreprendre une nouvelle reconstruction, marquée par les départs attendus de Massu, Quad et Gryffinn.

content:

SkewMond was not a free agent. G2 extended his deal in February 2026 and it was set to run until 2028, so the club had no reason to let him walk for nothing. Karmine Corp had to pay a transfer fee to get him out of that contract. The size of the fee has not been reported.

The two clubs settled the buyout on Tuesday, November 17, and SkewMond now has a verbal agreement in place with KC for next season.

Karmine Corp were not the only team chasing the French-Lebanese jungler. Team Vitality also made a move, and at one point they and G2 discussed a swap that would have sent Turkish top laner Naak Nako to G2 with SkewMond heading the other way. That idea died when Naak Nako signed with LYON in the LCS instead.

What slowed everything down was SkewMond himself. He wanted Karmine Corp, and that pushed talks into a standoff until G2 and KC agreed on a price.

This move has a strange echo. Two years ago, SkewMond took Yike's spot at G2 . Yike landed on his feet at Karmine Corp. Now Yike is reportedly off to Fnatic, and the player stepping into his old seat at KC is SkewMond, again.

Kim « Roach » Kang-hui, ancien entraîneur de l’équipe et double champion du monde en 2023 et 2024, serait pressenti pour revenir au poste de Head Coach après avoir terminé son service militaire. title: GTA 6 Reviews Are In: 99 on Metacritic, Tying the Highest Score Ever
content:
The first Grand Theft Auto VI reviews are out, and critics have handed Rockstar Games something close to a clean sweep. The review embargo lifted at 11:00 UTC on 18 November, which was 4:30pm in India and the same moment the game unlocked in New Zealand, as our New Zealand release time guide set out. By 4:40pm Indian time, OpenCritic showed a Top Critic Average of 98 from 52 reviews, with 100% of critics recommending the game. Metacritic followed minutes later, and by 4:46pm GTA VI had a Metascore of 99 from 100 critic reviews. That ties The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the highest Metascore any game has ever received, and it beats the series record of 98 that GTA IV set in 2008.

Most of the early verdicts are perfect scores. Push Square, Screen Rant, DualShockers and the Korean outlet Inven all gave GTA VI 10 out of 10, while VGC, GamesRadar+, TechRadar, Giant Bomb, The Guardian and Digital Spy gave it five stars. The lowest scores in that first wave were Wccftech’s 9.6 out of 10 and ZTGD’s 9 out of 10, and Metacritic counted no mixed or negative reviews among its first 100.

The open world is the clearest point of agreement among reviewers. Push Square called it the deepest and densest open world since Red Dead Redemption 2, while GamesRadar+ described the game as “the highest-fidelity sandbox of its generation”. TechRadar and Inven both pointed to random events and unscripted moments that make Leonida feel alive between missions.

The two leads have landed well with critics too. VGC, Screen Rant and TechRadar all praised the chemistry between Jason and Lucia, and VGC ranked the pair among Rockstar’s best characters. The radio stations, soundtrack and sound design come up again and again, alongside the visual detail that VGC and TechRadar both single out.

Reviewers also highlight the new systems layered over the familiar GTA formula. Push Square praised the wanted system, the stealth options and a romance system, and Inven noted a heat-based police pursuit and a crime profile. Those match what Rockstar described before launch, when it said a criminal profile would track how violent each player is, as covered in our report on Rockstar’s empathy comments .

Performance is the most common complaint in the early reviews. GTA VI targets 30fps on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and Push Square found no 60fps or performance mode even on PS5 Pro, as our report on GTA 6’s 30fps target explained before launch. VGC noticed occasional slowdowns in the busiest areas but described them as rare, while TechRadar said players who cannot accept 30fps may want to wait for a PC version, which Rockstar has not announced.

title: New Zealand’s Tourism Board Invites GTA 6 Players to ‘Join Us’ and Play Early
content:
New Zealand’s official tourism body has joined the GTA 6 launch hype by inviting players who use the “New Zealand trick” to come and join its residents. Tourism New Zealand , the government agency that markets the country abroad, posted a 12-second reel on its Pure New Zealand Instagram account at 10:50am New Zealand time on 18 November. That was 3:20am in India, and roughly 13 hours before Grand Theft Auto VI was due to unlock in the country.

The caption jokes that “one perk of seeing the sun first” is “getting GTA 6 first too”, before adding a direct nod to players elsewhere. It continues: “We heard a few of you are trying the New Zealand trick to join us. We get it, and we’d love to have you.” The post is tagged #NZMustDo, #NZBucketList and #GTA6, which puts a holiday pitch in front of gamers during the biggest launch week of the year.

The clip opens on a drone shot of a swimmer floating in clear water at Kaiteriteri Beach in Nelson Tasman. The on-screen text reads “Life, because we’re getting GTA 6 first”, laid out like a menu option. By Wednesday afternoon in India, the reel had about 1,500 likes and 34 comments on an account with 1.2 million followers.

GTA VI does not unlock at one moment around the world. The game goes live at midnight local time on 19 November in each region, and New Zealand reaches that point first, at 11:00 UTC on 18 November. That is 4:30pm in India, 11am in London and 6am on the US East Coast, as our New Zealand release time guide sets out.

Every other region then follows in turn as midnight moves west. Australia unlocks two hours after New Zealand, India 7.5 hours after, the UK 13 hours after and the US East Coast 18 hours after, according to our GTA 6 release times for every region . Players who pre-loaded the game after Rockstar opened pre-loads on 10 November can start as soon as their own region goes live.

title: Rockstar says it will kick GTA 6 spoilers trolls from its Discord as launch begins
content:
Rockstar Games has warned Grand Theft Auto VI players to be careful with spoilers as the game starts unlocking around the world. Anyone who spoils the story on purpose will be removed from its official Discord server. The warning went out to the server’s Announcements and Server Updates roles ahead of the first unlock on Wednesday. GTA VI goes live first in New Zealand at midnight local time, which is 4:30pm in India, before rolling west across the globe over the next day.

“Please be mindful of spoilers as Grand Theft Auto VI begins to launch across the globe,” Rockstar wrote. It added that it wants to ensure everyone experiences Jason and Lucia’s story for themselves. The post had drawn more than 11,000 emoji reactions in the server by Wednesday afternoon.

Rockstar said it will “publish some new GTAVI channels to the server very soon”. Story discussion will only be allowed in certain channels, and members are told to “always use spoiler tags when discussing major story moments”. On Discord, that means wrapping text in two pairs of vertical bars or typing /spoiler before a message, as Discord’s spoiler tag guide explains.

The penalty is aimed at deliberate spoilers rather than accidents. “Intentionally posting spoilers to troll other Discord members will result in your removal from the server,” Rockstar wrote, pointing members to an updated rules channel. The message signed off with “See you all in Leonida”, close to the line Rockstar posted on X when the game was a week away.

Rockstar’s wider rules go beyond its own Discord. Its policy on posting Rockstar material says videos showing “the ending of the game” or “any other big reveal in the story” will be taken down, along with edited compilations of cutscenes and plot dialogue. Cutscenes are allowed inside a longer playthrough or a narrated Let’s Play, but isolated videos of the game’s cinematics will be removed.

GTA VI is not launching at one moment worldwide. As our GTA 6 release times guide explains, it unlocks at 12am local time on 19 November in each region, starting in New Zealand at 11:00 UTC on 18 November. That gives players in Auckland a head start of several hours over most of Asia and close to a full day over the Americas.

title: Call of Duty Ranked Levels: Every Skill Division and What Carries Into a New Title
content:
Call of Duty ranked levels in mainline multiplayer Ranked Play run from Bronze to a Top 250 leaderboard finish. Black Ops 7 treats a new season differently depending on whether you finished below Platinum, and a new title begins its own progression. Warzone and Call of Duty Mobile have separate ranked systems.

Black Ops 7 Ranked Play has seven named Skill Divisions that group players by rank, followed by Top 250, a place on the leaderboard for the highest-ranked competitors. In order, the eight ladder positions are Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Crimson, Iridescent, and Top 250. Top 250 is a leaderboard position rather than another ordinary division to grind through. As a new player, you’ll receive a starting rank only after winning the required placement matches.

This is the Black Ops 7 multiplayer ladder; Warzone and Call of Duty Mobile use their own ranked systems.

Players in the Bronze division through Gold keep their rank and SR when a new season starts, but players in Platinum and above need a placement win. Rank is only part of what a profile carries, though: building one from scratch with the level, weapons, and camos you want takes a long run of matches. Players who would rather start from a finished profile can browse Call of Duty accounts on Skycoach , a marketplace where each Black Ops 7, Modern Warfare 4, or Warzone account listing shows whether it is ranked-ready, along with its level, Prestige, camo count, weapons, and the platforms it links to (PC, PlayStation, or Xbox). Skycoach has operated since 2020, and purchases come with buyer protection: a warranty period, a refund policy, and 24/7 support.

Black Ops 7 starts with placements. You must win three placement matches to receive a starting rank, and after each placement win, the Minimum Starting Rank updates to show a projection of where you’re expected to land.

After a Ranked Play win, you gain Skill Rating (SR), which sets your position on the ladder. The amount isn’t fixed: it depends on your match performance relative to the skill of the other players and the team’s margin of victory. The same factors affect SR deducted after a loss. As Activision’s ranked support page explains, the SR change depends on these match factors, so two wins during the same evening can award different amounts without an error in the display.

title: GTA 6 Pre-Loads Just Broke Virgin Media’s Broadband Records, Beating Arsenal and Fortnite
content:
GTA 6 pre-loads gave Virgin Media its busiest day on record, eight days before the game is even out. In a press release on 11 November , Virgin Media O2 said its UK broadband network set new highs for both peak traffic and total daily data on Tuesday 10 November. Peak traffic beat the previous record, set during Arsenal’s Champions League semi-final against Atlético Madrid, by 3.8%. Total data for the day was 4% higher than the previous best, which was set only on 1 November by the launch of Fortnite’s Chapter 7 Mini Season.

The rush started as soon as downloads opened. Between midnight and 1am UK time on 10 November, which is also midnight to 1am UTC in winter, Virgin Media recorded a 51.6% rise in broadband traffic compared with the same hour a week earlier. By 9am, the total data downloaded was 73.3% higher than over the same period on Tuesday 3 November. At 23:05 UTC, the network passed its previous record for an entire day’s data, with almost an hour of Tuesday still to go. Virgin Media O2 did not say how many customers pre-loaded the game, or publish its peak traffic in terabits per second.

Grand Theft Auto VI pre-loading is now available for everyone who has pre-ordered. If you still have yet to pre-order, now’s the time to make sure you're prepared for November 19: https://t.co/LUoPLobocD pic.twitter.com/TLtJUSFBwN

Virgin Media puts the game at 190GB, slightly less than the 212GB of free space we reported in our GTA 6 pre-load guide . The company says customers on its fastest Gig2 broadband service can download it in under 15 minutes. Our own calculation, at full line speed with no overheads, gives just under 13 minutes on a 2Gbps connection. On a 100Mbps line, the same download would take more than four hours, so many players will want to start well before launch day.

Pre-loading was always likely to strain networks, given how many people have already bought the game. GTA 6 has become the most pre-ordered game on record, with an estimated 9.69 million pre-orders, according to Sensor Tower. Rockstar’s own pre-load announcement also confirmed that the game targets 30 frames per second on consoles, which has caused a backlash among players . That debate has done little to slow the downloads, judging by Virgin Media’s figures.

Virgin Media O2 also published polling from Strand Partners, a member of the British Polling Council , which surveyed 520 UK adults who expect to play the game on 30 October. Nearly half (46%) said they expect to download GTA 6 before release day, and 45% expect to spend at least £50 on gaming kit, not counting the game. More than three-quarters (78%) have changed, or plan to change, their schedules to find time to play. Almost a quarter (23%) expect to stay up later or sleep less, and 22% plan to keep a whole weekend free.

title: Best Permanent Unlocks to spend Tokens on in Modern Warfare 4
content:
Classic Prestige has returned in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and that means that Permanent Unlock Tokens are coming back as well. If you’re unfamiliar with how Prestige Mode works, it resets your level back to one, but you receive a Permanent Unlock Token that you can use on any class item in multiplayer in exchange.

This is a huge benefit, as it lets you permanently unlock an item so you never have to unlock it again during the entire Prestige grind in Modern Warfare 4 . However, with so many items to choose from, which unlock gives you the best bang for your buck?

Below, we’ll give you five distinct class items in MW4 multiplayer that are most worth spending a Permanent Unlock Token on after you Prestige. The item list is in order from 1-5.

First on the list has to be the Stim, which is a piece of Tactical Equipment that quickly heals you back to full health when applied. The Stim is unlocked at level 47 in MW4 multiplayer, making it one of the final items you’ll unlock every single Prestige.

While there are other solid pieces of Tactical Equipment you can use until that level, once you get used to the Stim, there’s really no going back. The ability to get back into the fight instantly after being injured, compared to waiting for several seconds to recoup health, is one of the most important benefits of any item in multiplayer. If you use a Permanent Unlock Token on the Stim, your Tactical slot is pretty much set in stone on all loadouts in multiplayer.

Next up, we have the Axion assault rifle, which is unlocked at level 52. The Axion is one of the best assault rifles in Modern Warfare 4, and having it available for only three levels every Prestige is ultimately a waste of its potential. This is arguably a top meta weapon in multiplayer, so you’ll want it permanently unlocked as soon as possible.

title: How to get Ledge Hanging Kills in Modern Warfare 4
content:

Fortunately, thanks to the release of some post-launch content in MW4, Ledge Hanging Kills aren’t an issue at all. So, if you want to see exactly how to earn Ledge Hanging Kills quickly, check out the guide below.

Ledge Hanging Kills require you to mantle halfway up an object, hang in the air, and then use your gun in a single hand to kill enemies. This is extremely difficult on its own, as there really aren’t that many objects that can be ledge-hung from on multiplayer maps in MW4.

However, there is one major exception to this rule. On the map Shipment, there are some red crates on the side of the map near the wooden pallets and ruined car. On either side of these red crates, you can jump up to the middle ledge and hang from it. You can see us performing the ledge hang from the red crate in the screenshot below.

From this position, you need to wait for enemies to come around the corner in front of you or from the crate’s exit right below you. Either way, you’ll be able to kill them fairly easily from this position, as no enemy expects you to be hanging off the side of the crate.

Of course, once you get a kill in this position, enemies will likely hunt you down, so it’s wise to move to different sides of the red crate to cause some confusion. In any case, though, you now have a bona fide spot to earn your Ledge Hanging Kills in Modern Warfare 4.

title: FaZe Clan’s 11.11.26 Teaser Is a $100,000 Call of Duty Tournament: What We Know About FaZe’s Return
content:
FaZe Clan’s cryptic “11.11.26” post now has its first answer: a $100,000 Call of Duty tournament. A few hours after the date appeared on FaZe’s X account on 9 November, the organisation released a trailer for the Flank Invitational, a two-day event on 11 and 12 November. It will be streamed on FaZe’s Twitch channel and on the channel of former Call of Duty pro ZooMaa. The teaser, FaZe’s first original post since March, had passed 600,000 views by Tuesday, and the account’s bio now reads only “11.11.26”.

ZooMaa’s tournament brand, The Flank, confirmed the details in a post on X headed “FAZE X THE FLANK”. It listed a “12 team fantasy draft” on 10 November, followed by the tournament itself on 11 and 12 November. ZooMaa, who still goes by FaZe ZooMaa on X, thanked “the team at @FaZeClan for getting this done” and said the teams would be drafted on Tuesday. FaZe has not said whether the tournament is the whole announcement, or the start of something bigger.

FaZe’s 41-second trailer opens with the words “FaZe Clan presents” over Call of Duty gameplay, and closes on a card reading “$100K Flank Invitational, November 11-12”. In between, it promises a double-elimination bracket across three modes: Hardpoint, Search and Destroy and Hijack. The maps shown carry the Korean street signs of Modern Warfare 4, the current Call of Duty, whose launch patch notes landed in October. No team list, player list or prize split had been published by Tuesday morning, India time.

The fantasy draft format has a history at The Flank. The Flank has run invitationals for Call of Duty League players since 2024, when ZooMaa announced a $100,000 series of Black Ops 6 events for pros. Its last edition, a $20,000 tournament in November 2025, was won by a four-player squad that included CDL player Dashy. In October, ZooMaa said in a clip shared by the account SpawnUp that this year’s event was “not even full teams bc they wouldn’t let me do it, again”, without naming who had blocked full rosters.

The teaser lands almost a year after FaZe’s creator side fell apart. In the last week of 2025, Adapt, JasonTheWeen, Lacy, Silky and Stable Ronaldo announced they were leaving, and FaZe veterans including Apex, Swagg and Rug followed. Bloomberg reported that Matt Kalish, the DraftKings co-founder who invested in FaZe Media in 2024, had asked creators to sign with his new agency, HardScope, or go independent, calling the old model “unsustainable”. On 28 December, FaZe said it was “heartbreaking to see this era of FaZe come to a close”, and that esports would become “our main focus moving forward”.

The main account has been close to silent since then, apart from a $10,000 Modern Warfare 2 trickshot challenge in March. Several of the departed creators moved on together, with Adapt, Silky, JasonTheWeen, Lacy, Marlon and Stable Ronaldo launching a new group, CORE, on 30 April. Co-founder Richard “Banks” Bengtson, who rebooted FaZe in 2024 before stepping down as chief executive in July 2025, replied to the teaser within an hour. “Although I have no part in whatever’s next for this brand, I will always root for its success,” he wrote , adding: “Thank you for changing my life.”

title: Call of Duty Chat Over FaceTime Sparks Bomb Scare and Evacuation at California’s Ontario Airport
content:
A Frontier Airlines plane and part of a terminal at California’s Ontario International Airport were evacuated on Sunday night, after a passenger mistook a man’s Call of Duty chat for a bomb threat. The man had been talking to a friend over FaceTime while the friend played the game, and another passenger heard him mention a bomb. A sweep of the aircraft found no explosive device, and police concluded that no crime had been committed, according to reports. The scare has since become one of the most shared gaming stories on X, where it reached the platform’s Today’s News section.

The incident took place at around 10pm local time on Sunday, 8 November, as the Frontier flight was preparing to depart. According to CBS Los Angeles , a passenger waiting on board heard someone say the words “bomb” and “explosion” and reported it to the crew. The California Post , which spoke to the Ontario Police Department, reported that the passenger heard the man say that “he had a bomb in his backpack”. Neither outlet reported the flight number or where the plane was heading.

Officers detained the man for questioning and confirmed that he was carrying a backpack, police spokesperson Denyse Quezada told the California Post. Passengers were taken off the plane, and the east side of Terminal 2 was cleared while flights were held. A bomb-sniffing dog team searched the aircraft and the surrounding area and found nothing dangerous, according to the same report. The Ontario Fire Department and a bomb squad also responded within minutes.

The man told investigators he had been on FaceTime with a friend who was playing the game online. “The friend was playing a video game called ‘Call of Duty,'” Quezada said, adding that “the subject’s statement was related to a video game and not an actual explosive”. Investigators contacted the friend, who backed up his account, and the man was released. Airport spokesperson Steve Lambert later said the investigation was complete and that operations at Ontario International Airport were resuming.

Reports differ on what happened to the man after he was cleared. CBS Los Angeles reported that all passengers, “including the detained individual”, got back on the plane for departure. The California Post said that everyone except the man was allowed to reboard. The Ontario Police Department had not posted about the incident on its official X account at the time of writing.

For Call of Duty players, talk of bombs and explosions is ordinary match commentary. Search and Destroy, one of the series’ best-known modes, is built entirely around planting or defusing a bomb, and explosives such as C4 and grenades are standard equipment. The mode is a fixture of competitive Call of Duty, and it returns in this year’s Modern Warfare 4, which drew mixed reactions at launch . Out of context, a single excited line from a match can sound alarming to anyone sitting nearby.
